settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: Optional. Leave empty to use the built-in LIFTD mark, which takes one colour from the ground it sits on. Minimum display width is 96px.

settings.label: Storefront public access token
settings.info: Enables the cart shared with stayliftd.com (see CART_CONTRACT.md). This is the PUBLIC Storefront API token — safe to expose to browsers; never paste the private delegate token here. Leave empty to fall back to the standalone native cart.

settings.label: Main site URL
settings.info: The primary brand site. The storefront links back to it in the footer.
